scope: Authorized mayyhem.com lab; PS1 site. Execution observations from PS1-DEV, PS1-PSS, PS1-DB and PS1-SMS.
importantLimits: A rejected console command is not always a provider permission-denial proof. Raw error details are retained.
Site Manage Status Filters without Site Read produced a console lookup error; its minimum direct-provider read requirement remains unresolved.
The applications experiment contains five completed cases; its earlier missing-Read attempt returned no assignment and is excluded from the completed-case list.
Prepared-object deployment demonstrates starting existing code. The separate author-and-deploy experiments prove the account can supply its own code.
Original role definitions were compared before and after testing; their names and permission masks were unchanged.
